subject: Expansion forecast — Q4 commit cadence & CS checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Carter <evan@prismhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion forecast — Q4 commit cadence & CS checklist

Hi Evan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — great to see the product mapping into your clinician workflow. Monica and Kimberly are looped to make sure we align on the rollout and forecast.

Quick ask from our side as we finalize the Q4 forecast: can you confirm whether Prism plans to accelerate the pilot to a 50-seat expansion by Dec 15, or keep to the original phased rollout into Q1? That timing materially affects capacity planning and the discount cadence we can offer for a committed expansion.

To make this concrete I attached a short mutual action plan and an updated SOW draft. If you can mark the expected expansion date in the sheet (column: Expected Expansion Date) and indicate decision owner, Monica will pick this up and confirm commit level for finance.

Next steps we propose:
- Evan: mark anticipated expansion date + decision owner in the MAP (by Mon 11/9)
- Monica: validate commit tier and update forecast (by Tue 11/10)
- Kimberly: prepare revised pricing snapshot + any required SLA language (by Wed 11/11)

If the timing is uncertain, we can plan for a conditional commit (partial reserved capacity + option to scale) — happy to walk through the numbers with you.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0129

Attachments: Prism_Q4_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-draft-PrismHealth-v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Evan Carter <evan@prismhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Singh <lara.singh@prismhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion forecast — Q4 commit cadence & CS checklist

Thanks, Dylan.

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers: leadership wants to see stronger pilot telemetry before committing to a Dec 15 expansion — current ask is to aim for early Jan rollout, with a potential fast-follow to Dec if adoption spikes in the next pilot week. I'll flag the decision owner as Lara Singh (Head of Clinical Ops) and put "early Jan" in the MAP for now.

Two notes for your team:
1) We need confirmation on the pre-prod data retention settings and whether audit logs can be exported daily (compliance required).
2) Pricing sensitivity: the difference between the 25% and 35% commit tier is material; we'll need a short summary of what we get at each tier beyond pure discount (SLA, priority capacity).

I'll update the spreadsheet today.

—Evan

--
Evan Carter
Director of IT & Clinical Integrations
Prism Health
Phones: 415-555-2102
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Carter <evan@prismhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion forecast — Q4 commit cadence & CS checklist

Thanks for the update, Evan — and thanks for flagging the compliance ask.

Short answers from the ops side:
- Data retention & audit exports: Yes — we can configure daily export of audit logs to an S3 bucket in your account. I'll include the required KMS key/permissions language in the SOW.
- Commit tiers: Dylan, Kimberly and I put together a one-page summary that outlines the incremental operational benefits at each tier (priority scheduling windows, SLA uplift, dedicated support hours). Kimberly attaching the snapshot separately.

Forecast action items on our side:
- I'll mark the MAP with "early Jan" as Evan suggested, and set a conservative commit assumption at 25% tier for the finance forecast. If adoption exceeds the pilot threshold, we'll move the assumption to 35% and notify Finance to adjust the Q4 numbers.
- I'll also add a forecast note in HubSpot with a link to the MAP and the SOW draft so RevOps sees the contingency plan.

Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pricing-tier-summary-onepager.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Carter <evan@prismhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion forecast — Q4 commit cadence & CS checklist

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. Summary and asks (single-threaded):

1) Evan: please keep the MAP updated with any change to the Target Expansion Date. You indicated "early Jan" for now; we'll treat Dec as a stretch target if telemetry looks good.
2) Monica: set forecast assumption = 25% commit tier for now and add a HubSpot note with the contingency trigger (pilot adoption > 60% active seats for 7 consecutive days => auto-escalate to 35% commit). Can you do that by Mon 11/9 so Finance has an updated commit number for the weekly sweep?
3) Kimberly: please upload the one-pager pricing summary to the shared Drive folder and add the SLA bullet points into the SOW draft (no later than Tue 11/10).

I'll also schedule a 30-minute handoff with Monica + Lara next week to walk through the rollout checklist and run a short capacity model so Prism can see the marginal cost impact of moving from 25% to 35% commit. Proposed times: Tue 11/10 10:00am PT or Wed 11/11 2:00pm PT — Evan, which is better for Lara?

If we get the MAP updated and Monica posts the forecast note by Monday, I'll mark this deal as "Commit: conditional (25%)" in hubspot and notify RevOps.

Best,
Dylan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
